title: Spatial Follow + Image Prompt · v0.5.0
changes: Upright small XR toolbar, following the viewer just below eye line by default; Pin mode keeps the toolbar in the room and both modes are draggable.
Captured source photo remains in place during extraction; object crops bloom from the original on curved trajectories instead of rebuilding the entire scene.
EXTRACT, PROMPT and REFINE replace exposed model-family terminology in immersive controls; Meta routing stays under the hood.
Prompt any saved source or object photo; send one explicit paid Muse Image edit and keep the generated child alongside the original, privately saved.
Speech-to-text for short microphone instructions and a keyboard prompt editor with XR DOM-overlay fallback; microphone compatibility depends on Quest Browser.
Controller and hand grip orientation supports free card rotation; two-input distance scales a selected object, and capture/card positions are persisted.
Backend allows unlimited request quota when FREE_LAB_DAILY_LIMIT=0 and FREE_LAB_USER_DAILY_LIMIT=0; provider billing remains separate. No change to encrypted provider keys.
3D and video adapters are intentionally not activated until provider-specific paid workflows and tests exist.
